mapper.select: SELECT T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodId, T2.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, T1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, '系统参数日终自动交收为否，不进行自动交收。' remark FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T8 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T8.TRADE_ID WHERE (T8.SETTLE_SEQ_NO IS NULL OR T8.SETTLE_STATUS = #{DELIVERY_STATUS_01}) AND T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_09},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_10},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_11}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_35},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_36},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_37}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_20},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_51},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_52}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_74},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_75},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_76},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_77}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_105},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_106},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_107},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_108}) AND T1.TRADE_STATUS =#{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND T1.Is_Cancel =#{isCalcN} AND T1.SETTLE_DATE = #{checkDate} union all SELECT T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodId, T2.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, T1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, '系统参数日终自动交收为否，不进行自动交收。' remark FROM TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T8 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T8.TRADE_ID WHERE (T8.SETTLE_SEQ_NO IS NULL OR T8.SETTLE_STATUS = #{DELIVERY_STATUS_01}) AND T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_09},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_10},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_11}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_35},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_36},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_37}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_20},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_51},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_52}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_74},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_75},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_76},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_77}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_105},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_106},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_107},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_108}) AND T1.TRADE_STATUS =#{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND T1.Is_Cancel =#{isCalcN} AND T1.SETTLE_DATE = #{checkDate}
